name: expeditions
description: A local pixel-art battle window that follows your agent sessions. Requires Node 22 or newer.

interface.shortDescription: Local battles alongside your agent sessions
interface.longDescription: Watch your agent session as a pixel-art battle on your machine. See spell recommendations from Proving Grounds trials, collect local progress and choose whether Guide mode adds a short note to the conversation. Requires Node 22 or newer. Approve the plugin hooks in /hooks after installing or updating.
